extractor.method: Static archive extraction and ASCII inventory; no game execution, DLL loading, process access or disassembly.

unresolved.engineDefaults: ASCII names do not establish registered types/defaults. Prior research/convars.txt is not a fresh build-pinned source and is not consumed.
unresolved.throw: m_flThrowVelocity is a weapon-data input, not the final launch speed. Launch multiplier, strength curve, player-velocity inheritance, pitch transform, hand offset and release delay require native-code evidence.
unresolved.detonation: HE/flash fuse, smoke/decoy rest threshold and check cadence, decoy duration, fire collision/detonation conditions and smoke lifetime are not exposed numerically in extracted vdata/CFG.
unresolved.physics: Projectile gravity multiplier, hull, bounce restitution/friction, sleep speed and collision masks require native-code evidence. sv_gravity ASCII presence alone supplies no default.
unresolved.effects: Weapon m_nDamage/m_flRange/m_flArmorRatio are preserved as fields, not assumed blast/flash/decoy formulas. No inference from particle durations or presentation sounds.
unresolved.configuration: CFG assignments are overrides, not engine defaults. modeExec preserves declared order/offline condition; absent server CFGs and official environment overrides are not invented.
